info.name: Metr — User Service + Content Service
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for **both** running backends.

| Service | Variable | Local URL | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **User Service** | `{{userBaseUrl}}` | http://localhost:3000 | Auth, OTP, profile, photo, follows, search |
| **Content Service** | `{{contentBaseUrl}}` | http://localhost:3001 | About, Help, Version, Languages, Contact, admin CMS |

**Setup**
1. Start user-service on 3000 and content-service on 3001.
2. Collection variables are already set. Change `adminKey` if your content-service `.env` `ADMIN_API_KEY` is different.
3. User Service → Auth → Sign up, then copy the 6-digit OTP from the **user-service terminal** into `otpCode`.
4. Run Verify OTP. `accessToken` and `userId` are saved automatically.
5. Follows need an advertiser UUID in `advertiserId` (`UPDATE users SET "isAdvertiser" = true WHERE id = '…'` — there is no upgrade API).

**Headers**
- JSON: `Content-Type: application/json`
- JWT routes: `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`
- Admin CMS: `x-admin-key: {{adminKey}}`

**Errors:** `{ "error": "CODE", "message": { "en": "...", "ar": "..." } }`

item.name: User Service
item.description:
http://localhost:3000 — auth, profile, photo, follows, search.

Run Auth → Sign up → paste OTP into `otpCode` → Verify OTP, then Profile / Users & Follows.

request.description: Liveness for user-service.
No JWT. `{ available: true | false }`. Invalid format → 400 USERNAME_INVALID.
Starts OTP. User is created only after verify. Saves `sessionId`. Copy OTP from user-service console into `otpCode`.
OTP for an existing phone. 404 PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED if unknown.
6 digits, 2 min TTL, 3 attempts, then 5 min lock. Saves `accessToken` and `userId`.
30s cooldown, max 3 resends per session.
JWT. `{ ok: true }`. Token is dead after this.
JWT. Permanently deletes the user.
JWT. Current user + follow stats. Prefix `photoUrl` with userBaseUrl to load the image.
